proofDescriptions.lean: Substantial formalization of the stated result in Lean. The explanation on each result names its scope and any external theorem interfaces.
proofDescriptions.written: A written argument with self-review or internal proof review. The explanation identifies the result and its assumptions.
proofDescriptions.explored: An unresolved question with established intermediate results, constructions or checked examples. The explanation states what is complete and what remains open.

geometry-recovery.scope: Written coefficient stability, convex moment reconstruction and sample-recovery bounds for fixed complexity and separated, bounded boundaries. The core theorem has a separate internal proof review; the later sampling and conditioning results have recorded self-checks.
geometry-recovery.brief: Dimension-independent coefficient stability, convex reconstruction from label moments, and recovery bounds for corrupted samples.

multiplication-tables.scope: Complete written stabilization argument, a separate internal review and exact finite checks. The sharp lower bound concerns selected alphabets; the upper bound also applies to the complete multiplication table. The proof uses established circuit-to-stabilization and Hilbert-series results.
multiplication-tables.brief: A sharp worst-alphabet scale for polynomial stabilization, including an improved upper bound for the complete multiplication table.

distinct-products.scope: Written proof with internal re-derivation of the main combinatorial and sieve steps.
distinct-products.brief: An upper bound toward the triple-product case of Erdős problem 425.

finite-symmetry.scope: Written proof of the 4/9 structure theorem and its exact extremal consequences in the specified finite abelian groups. Specific finite density, quotient and fibre deductions are also checked in Lean.
finite-symmetry.brief: Index-seven structure and exact extremal Cayley graphs in specified finite abelian groups.

factor-packing.scope: Written arithmetic repair and depth arguments with recorded internal reviews. A separate, self-checked correction of an earlier multiplication-table example gives larger families of missing elements and associated Picard-group consequences.
factor-packing.brief: Persistent factorization obstructions, larger families of missing elements, and a positive-proportion depth deficit.

hidden-stages.scope: Written, self-reviewed threshold for populations with at most m exponential stages: m matched totals identify the hidden stage count and unordered rates, while m−1 can fail. Uniform estimator guarantees assume a positive rate floor. Exact identity checks supplement the proof.
hidden-stages.brief: An exact matched-repeat threshold for hidden exponential stages, with direct recovery of intervention responses.

recurring-prime-gaps.scope: Written four-point selection law and gcd classification, internally reviewed using Merikoski’s corrected four-group sieve and a fixed CRT construction. The modular corollary also uses the finite-group structure theorem.
recurring-prime-gaps.brief: A four-point selection law restricts the greatest common divisor of recurring consecutive-prime gaps to 2, 4 or 6.

arithmetic-tensors.scope: Written finite tensor results and an internally checked arithmetic transfer using external Koymans–Smith estimates. The later elliptic-curve deduction has written source reconstruction and exact finite self-checks, conditional on the named Cassels-pairing and analytic inputs.
arithmetic-tensors.brief: Distribution and rank guarantees for prime-symbol arrays, with a further application to quadratic twists of an elliptic curve.

matching-stability.scope: Written global matching theorem with independent internal review. Constants depend on the number of boundaries and the threshold bound, independently of ambient dimension; colliding boundaries are allowed.
matching-stability.brief: A linear bound matches Gaussian decision boundaries even when coincident boundaries cancel.

noisy-boundary-recovery.scope: Written degree-three ambiguity and degree-four inversion for two distinct centered boundaries, Gaussian inputs and class-dependent flip rates whose sum is below one. The proof includes perturbation bounds and internally reviewed model scope.
noisy-boundary-recovery.brief: An exact degree-three ambiguity is resolved by degree-four measurements, recovering two boundaries and both unknown noise rates.

prime-patterns.scope: The original matching-based gap bound is substantially formalized in Lean, conditional on quantitative Selberg and labelled Bennett–Frieze inputs. A separate written Rankin-style adaptation gives the larger bound displayed in the comparison.
prime-patterns.brief: Two fixed-pattern sieve-gap constructions, with the original conditional deduction formalized in Lean.

limits-of-evidence.scope: Written finite probability calculation, checked internally. The badge applies to this calculation.
limits-of-evidence.brief: The exact change needed to erase a joint event while preserving its marginal rates.
